snippet.title: CORDILLERA - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Far far away, lies a land high above the Clouds.

Take Aethel and her friend Luna on an adventure across the beautiful Cordillera. To save an ancient people on the brink of extinction from an Old Evil.

Out October 27th for PC and MAC.

Buy it now in a bundle (includes the soundtrack) : http://toothandclaw.itch.io/cordillera-bundle-pack
Buy the Game (standalone) : http://toothandclaw.itch.io/cordillera
Buy the OST here : http://toothandclaw.itch.io/cordillera-ost

Follow our Dev blog : http://toothandclawgames.tumblr.com/
Follow me on Twitter : https://twitter.com/DanInFiction
